name: macp_decision_proposal
description: Proposal: creates an option for the participants to consider (RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4). Sent as message_type Proposal in mode macp.mode.decision.v1.

proposal_id.description: Identifier of this proposal, unique within the Session. Later Evaluation, Objection and Vote messages reference it.

rationale.description: Why the sender proposes this option.

supporting_data.description: Opaque supporting data; empty if none. Base64-encoded (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 10.3).
